question: Which organization has inaugurated the 9th T20 National Cricket Championship for Deaf 2025 in New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Deaf Cricket Association (IDCA).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Deaf Cricket Association (IDCA) inaugurated the 9th T20 National Cricket Championship for Deaf 2025 at Essex Farm Cricket Ground, Chhawla, New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The championship is supported by the BCCI and recognized by the Deaf International Cricket Council and the Asian Deaf Cricket Association.**
 
• The event, held under the patronage of the Cyrus Poonawalla Group, runs from November 3 to 9, 2025.
 
• **20 teams from across India are competing, including from Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Delhi, Punjab, and Maharashtra.**
 
• Matches are hosted across four venues in Chhawla — Essex Farms, Harryan Cricket Academy, Arihant Cricket Ground, and Arihant Mount Cricket Club.

 [IMAGE: //cdn.testbook.com/resources/lms_creative_elements/additional-info-image.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The tournament schedule includes 40 league matches, quarter-finals, semi-finals, and a grand final on November 9.
 
• Sumit Jain (President, IDCA) and Roma Balwani (CEO, IDCA) emphasized inclusivity and visibility for hearing-impaired athletes.
 
• The event celebrates resilience, teamwork, and sportsmanship in differently-abled cricket.
